rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: South Seas
rows.Origin:
Bred by Dr. Dennison H. Morey (United States, 1960).
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (Newark, NY) in 1962 as 'South Seas'.
Introduced in Australia by Hazlewood Bros. Pty. Ltd. in 1964 as 'South Seas'.
Introduced in France by Vilmorin-Andrieux in 1964 as 'Mers du Sud'.
rows.Bloom: Coral-pink. Moderate fragrance. 48 petals. Average diameter 6.5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Leathery foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
